In the chart's table view, Spain has the highest solar share of the four countries for 2025, the latest year shown. I read the values from the full country list rather than from a filtered selection of the four.

| Country | Share of electricity from solar, 2025 |
|---|---|
| Spain | 21.85% |
| Germany | 17.91% |
| Italy | 16.86% |
| Poland | 11.28% |

Spain's 21.85% rounds to 21.9%.

ANSWER: Spain, 21.9
